# Routable Definition Base

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `route.base` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/route.yaml` |
| Tags | route, abstract |

Abstract base for definitions discoverable by the router. Children
declare:
  - intent_affinity: list of intent labels this route serves
    (e.g. ["RESEARCH", "SUMMARIZE"]).
  - tier: complexity tier — "LOCAL", "HYBRID", "FRONTIER", or "AGENT".
  - cost: relative cost integer (0 = free local, 10 = frontier API).
  - deferred_model: optional model id used when tier is FRONTIER and
    the dispatcher should defer to the caller (e.g. "claude-sonnet-4-6").
The classifier produces a TaskProfile; the scorer ranks every route
whose `has_route` catalog flag is True; the dispatcher invokes the
winner via `runtime.execute(route_id, arguments={"task": <text>,
"context": <ctx>})`.
